تستقبلون (form X)
# تَسْتَقْبِلُونَ (tastaqbilūna) /tas.taq.bi.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْبَلَ (istaqbala)
# تُسْتَقْبَلُونَ (tustaqbalūna) /tus.taq.ba.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْبَلَ (istaqbala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
